description: Scans the ai-agents-for-beginners course repo for drifted model pins and open package-version floors, signs the findings, and sells the full report to agents.
status: live since 2026-08-28 at https://signetworks.atelieri.workers.dev/mcp; x402 settlement mechanics proven 2026-08-28 (testnet)

endpoint.note: Served by the Cloudflare Worker at agent-economy/worker.

badge.returns: shields.io-compatible JSON badge reporting the worst status among the given model ids
badge.purpose: embeddable status check that does not require an MCP round trip

tools.name: drift_summary
tools.returns: finding counts by severity, affected lessons, critical subjects, and a signed receipt committing to the full findings set
tools.purpose: lets a buyer decide whether the paid report is worth it, at no cost

tools.name: verify_report
tools.returns: whether a receipt's Ed25519 signature is valid, and optionally whether a findings array matches the receipt's committed findings_hash
tools.purpose: lets a buyer audit the goods before paying and confirm they received everything after paying

tools.name: drift_report

payment.currency: USDC on Tempo testnet (unexercised; MPP settlement has not yet cleared a real payment)

tools.returns: every drift finding with file path, line number, diagnosis, and suggested fix
tools.purpose: the paid tier: replaces the maintainer work of tracing each finding by hand

tools.name: drift_report_x402

payment.network: eip155:84532 (Base Sepolia testnet, proven with two real settlements 2026-08-28)
payment.facilitator: https://x402.org/facilitator (testnet default; mainnet CDP facilitator required for x402 Bazaar indexing)

tools.purpose: discovery: the x402 Bazaar only indexes services that settle through an x402 facilitator, so this tool exists to be findable by agents holding on-chain budgets, not because the data differs

tools.name: model_status
tools.returns: a single model id's catalog entry (status, dates, replacement, source) plus the signed catalog receipt, or an honest unknown: not in catalog
tools.purpose: lets a buyer check one pinned model before deciding whether the paid batch tool is worth it

tools.name: model_status_batch

payment.currency: USDC on Tempo testnet (unexercised; MPP settlement has not yet cleared a real payment)

tools.returns: a caller's list of model ids resolved against the catalog, per-model entries plus an any_action_needed boolean gating on deprecated/retired status
tools.purpose: the paid tier: a CI pipeline or coding agent checks its whole set of pinned models in one call instead of one id at a time

tools.name: model_status_batch_x402

payment.facilitator: https://x402.org/facilitator (testnet default; mainnet CDP facilitator required for x402 Bazaar indexing)

tools.purpose: discovery: the x402 Bazaar only indexes services that settle through an x402 facilitator, so this tool exists to be findable by agents holding on-chain budgets, not because the data differs

tools.name: site_audit_summary
tools.returns: "N of 12 checks passed" for a submitted site URL, plus target and date
tools.purpose: lets a buyer decide whether the paid full audit is worth it, at no cost

tools.name: site_audit

payment.currency: USDC on Tempo testnet (unexercised; MPP settlement has not yet cleared a real payment)

tools.returns: all 12 agent-legibility checks for a submitted site URL, each with status and detail, as a signed dated receipt
tools.purpose: the paid tier: full per-check detail behind a signed, dated attestation of what was checked and when

tools.name: site_audit_x402

payment.facilitator: https://x402.org/facilitator (testnet default; mainnet CDP facilitator required for x402 Bazaar indexing)

tools.purpose: discovery: the x402 Bazaar only indexes services that settle through an x402 facilitator, so this tool exists to be findable by agents holding on-chain budgets, not because the data differs

verification.method: Ed25519 signature over the SHA-256 digest of RFC 8785 (JCS) canonical JSON
verification.findings_hash: sha256 of the canonical findings array; both the free and paid tiers commit to the same hash, so the free summary is a binding claim about what the paid tier contains
verification.how_to_verify: call verify_report with the receipt object from any response, and optionally the findings array from a paid response, to check the signature and the findings_hash match locally, no trust in the seller required
implementations_checked: agent-economy/tests/cross-language-verify.mjs (proves both agree, and that a tampered receipt or a short-changed findings array is rejected)
